name: Rice
description: Primary staple food crop of India, cultivated across vast wetland ecosystems, deltaic plains, and rainfed uplands. Heavily sensitive to water management, nitrogen timing, and blast/sheath blight pathogens.
climate: Hot and humid tropical to subtropical climate with prolonged sunshine during grain filling.

soil.drainage_requirement: Poor drainage tolerant; standing water of 2-5 cm maintained during active vegetative stage, drained prior to harvest.
soil.organic_matter_requirement: Moderate to High (>0.6% OC); benefits from green manuring with Sesbania (Daincha).

seed_rate_per_ha: 30-40 kg/ha for transplanted rice; 10-12 kg/ha for SRI method; 60-80 kg/ha for direct seeded rice.

growth_stages.description: Seed germination, radicle emergence, and seedling development in raised or wet nursery beds.
Establishment after transplanting, auxiliary bud proliferation into tillers, root anchoring.
critical_activities: First top dressing of Urea (25% N)

growth_stages.description: Microscopic panicle development inside the boot leaf sheath; maximum vegetative canopy.
critical_activities: Second top dressing (N and remaining K2O)
Maintain 5 cm water; prevent moisture stress

growth_stages.description: Exsertion of panicle, anthesis, milky stage to soft dough transition.
critical_activities: Keep soil saturated; avoid both submergence and cracking
Foliar 1% DAP or K spray if needed

growth_stages.description: Dough hardening, grain moisture falls from 24% to 18%, straw turns golden yellow.
critical_activities: Complete drainage of field 10 days before harvest

irrigation.frequency_days: Submerge 3 days after ponded water disappears (in AWD)

nutrients.basal_application: Full P2O5 (50 kg) + 25% N (30 kg) + 50% K2O (25 kg) + 25 kg Zinc sulphate/ha at final puddling.
top_dressing_schedule: 25% N (30 kg) at active tillering (21-25 DAT)
25% N (30 kg) + 50% K2O (25 kg) at panicle initiation (40-45 DAT)
Remaining 25% N (30 kg) at heading stage if crop shows pale green canopy
micronutrient_requirements: Zinc Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha basal or foliar 0.5% ZnSO4 spray for Khaira symptom correction

maturity_indices: 80-85% grains in panicles turn straw golden yellow
Lower grain on panicle is in hard dough stage
harvesting.harvesting_method: Cut plants with serrated sickle at 5-10 cm above ground level or combine harvester.
harvesting.post_harvest_care: Sun dry threshed paddy on clean tarpaulin to reach 12-14% moisture before storage in moisture-proof gunny bags.
